headline: Dhaka: PM instructs Karwan Bazar kitchen market relocation
summary: The Prime Minister has ordered the relocation of the Karwan Bazar kitchen market to ease congestion and improve urban management in the capital.
details: The Prime Minister has issued instructions to relocate the Karwan Bazar kitchen market, one of the city's largest and most central wholesale markets.
The move is intended to reduce the chronic traffic congestion and chaos associated with the market's current location in the heart of Dhaka.
Officials are expected to identify a suitable new site that can accommodate the market's scale while ensuring accessibility for traders and consumers.
The relocation is part of a broader effort to modernize the city's infrastructure and improve the overall flow of traffic in the central business district.

headline_marked: Commuters struggle as [[CNG shortage worsens]] in Dhaka
headline: Commuters struggle as CNG shortage worsens in Dhaka
summary: Drivers are enduring hours-long waits for fuel, causing widespread disruption to city transport.
details: A severe shortage of CNG-powered auto-rickshaws has intensified in Dhaka, leaving thousands of commuters stranded.
The crisis is primarily driven by fuel shortages, forcing drivers to spend hours in long queues at filling stations.
This shortage has led to increased fares and difficulty in finding available rides during peak hours.
Passengers are facing significant delays in reaching their destinations, further complicating the city's already congested traffic.
Transport workers are calling for urgent government intervention to stabilize fuel supplies and ensure smooth city transit.
